jobs.title: Project Manager (remote from Europe)
jobs.description:

Our comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic sensory solutions are designed to simplify workflows for sensory specialists, ensuring care teams have the right instrumentation to give patients the right support — and greater peace of mind.

Location:
Remote somewhere in Europe

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Project Manager with 6 to 9 years of experience
to lead the deployment, integration, and optimization of our core Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
systems, Artificial Intelligence (AI)
initiatives, and broader Business Applications
.

In this role, you will act as the vital bridge between our technical engineering teams, data scientists, and business stakeholders. You will drive end-to-end delivery of complex software environments, ensuring that our technical ecosystem aligns with organizational goals and scales efficiently. Exposure to or experience with Salesforce is a distinct plus
, but not a hard requirement.

Key Responsibilities

Project Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end execution of enterprise application projects, from initial scoping and requirement gathering through to design, implementation, UAT, deployment, and post-launch support.
ERP & Systems Integration: Oversee the planning, configuration, and roll-out of ERP modules and integrations with existing internal business applications to streamline operational workflows.
AI Solution Delivery: Partner with data science and engineering teams to deploy modern, AI-enabled delivery practices, automation tools, and machine learning models into everyday business operations.
Stakeholder & Change Management: Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional business heads to manage expectations, define clear KPIs, and drive organizational change management to ensure high user adoption of new tools.
Risk & Resource Management: Proactively identify project dependencies, technical blockers, and budget risks. Formulate strategic countermeasures to keep timelines on track without sacrificing quality.
Agile Governance: Facilitate standard agile/scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming) tailored to mixed software implementation models.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience: 6–9 years of dedicated project management experience within enterprise software implementation, specifically managing core business applications and ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite).
AI & Automation Exposure: Proven track record of managing projects that involve AI core concepts, LLM integrations, business process automation, or data analytics pipelines.
Methodologies: Strong mastery of Agile, Scrum, or SAFe frameworks alongside traditional Waterfall project governance.
Tools: High proficiency with modern project management and collaboration toolsets (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Asana).
Communication: Exceptional executive presence with the ability to translate dense technical architectures into clear, value-driven language for C-suite stakeholders.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. PMP, PMI-ACP, or Scrum Master (CSM) certifications are highly valued.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)

Hands-on implementation experience or structural knowledge of the Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or MuleSoft integrations).
Practical exposure to utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools within project delivery workflows.

Compensation and Benefits:
Along with a competitive salary and bonus structure, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to start on day one of employment: Health Insurance Benefits (60% paid by employer), 5 Weeks PTO, RTT days, and tuition reimbursement.

Join Natus Sensory today.
Confidence in every Sense.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Lifepoint Health has an opportunity for a Senior Technical Project Manager!

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship.

Location: Remote

Travel: Travel up to 25% overnight by land and/or air

Job Summary

The ITS, Senior Technical Project Manager partners with ITS Medication Management Informatics, Vendors and technical teams to establish project teams and direct the technology development components of Medication Management Informatics related projects from initiation through delivery and transition to formal long-term support. The role coordinates cross-functional teams, manages project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, and risks, and serves as a liaison between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Essential Functions

Project and Program Delivery

Manage multiple projects and programs for multiple stakeholders and teams under deadlines, often with short notice. Use project plans, status reports, and budgets to manage delivery; track time and resources and assist with vendor management.
Create, maintain, and manage project implementation and work plans, including project charters, schedules, RAID logs, Gantt charts, team structures, roles and responsibilities, and governance plans.
Coordinate projects from initiation through implementation and transition to formal long-term support, including leading communications during go-live events as needed.

Requirements, Workflow, And Stakeholder Coordination

Gather required data from end users, external suppliers, and key stakeholders to evaluate objectives, goals, and scope. Develop technical specifications, current-state and future-state data and workflow maps, and business and use cases.
Serve as a liaison and customer advocate between Clinical Informatics, Vendors, technical and non-technical departments. Facilitate meetings, manage agendas and minutes, and escalate risks to support achievement of project targets and requirements.
Provide guidance and mentoring to team members, facilitate effective team interaction, build relationships with business stakeholders, identify opportunities to increase customer satisfaction, and manage stakeholder expectations.

Project Documentation and Knowledge Sharing

Compile and maintain repositories of project deliverables, documentation, and best practices. Support team members in the use of deliverable templates.

Professional Responsibilities

Maintain regular and reliable attendance and perform other duties as assigned. Serve internal coworkers and external customers, clients, contractors, and vendors.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree required.

Experience

Minimum of 5 years of project management experience, including management of cross-functional technology, operations, and vendor teams, with demonstrated success meeting project goals, objectives, budgets, and timelines.

Certifications/Licensure

Current Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Understand project management methodologies established by the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) and Project Management Institute (PMI). Apply project planning and organization skills to manage simultaneous projects, delegate tasks, oversee delivery, and allocate resources.
Understand project types including centralizations, migrations, conversions, data integrity initiatives, new starts, acquisitions, expansions, and software and hardware implementations.
Use project management and communication tools, including Smartsheet or a similar project tracking tool, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint. Demonstrate intermediate computer skills in basic programming, relational databases, operating systems, and software packages.
Communicate complex information effectively with stakeholders through executive leadership. Present information, resolve delicate situations, and motivate and persuade others.
Analyze and interpret varied, complex business problems using professional knowledge, established precedents, and practices.
Exercise independent judgment to establish functional goals and priorities, resolve problems for others, and recommend departmental policies, practices, and programs. Understand the impact of decisions on departmental management and operations and contribute to business and operational decisions.
Understand healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements, including HIPAA; apply policies and procedures and demonstrate knowledge of business office standards and recommended practices.

Organizational Expectations

Maintains compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and supports hospital and department policies, procedures, and standards.
Consistently supports the mission, vision, values, and goals of the hospital and Lifepoint Health.
Acts in a positive, proactive, and professional manner when interacting with employees, leaders, physicians, patients, visitors, and community partners.
Maintains confidentiality, complies with HIPAA requirements, and handles sensitive business and patient information appropriately.
Demonstrates accountability for workplace safety and completes assigned education, training, and mandatory requirements in a timely manner.
Maintains required licensure, certification, and professional credentials, if applicable, in good standing.

Work Environment

Remote based position
Business hours from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Monday through Friday (40 hours weekly)- schedules may vary based on business necessity
Well-lit, ventilated, and climate-controlled office and hospital environments with routine office equipment. In hospital settings, the individual may be exposed to hazards and unusual elements that require appropriate safety precautions.
Travel up to 25% as required for business needs, including potential overnight travel by land and/or air.

jobs.description:
About The Company

Micron Technology Inc. is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence. Our products and technologies help people learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever. Guided by a vision to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all, Micron supports innovation across industries and around the globe.

Micron’s Construction & Engineering team delivers the world-class facilities that support the company’s manufacturing and innovation. Working across disciplines, the team builds safe, efficient, and reliable environments where employees can do their best work. Our projects help Micron grow, operate at scale, and meet the evolving needs of the semiconductor industry.

About The Role

Micron is seeking a Project Manager to lead complex construction projects from concept through completion. In this role, you will be accountable for project scope, schedule, budget, resources, and vendor performance. You will coordinate multidisciplinary teams and guide project activities to ensure safety, quality, and technical excellence are integrated throughout delivery.

This position is suited to a skilled construction leader who can bring structure to complex work, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and make informed decisions as project needs evolve. Your leadership will have a direct impact on the facilities that enable Micron’s manufacturing operations and future growth.

Qualifications

A degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field is preferred. Relevant professional certifications or licenses may also be considered. Candidates should have at least five years of experience serving as the primary project manager for highly technical construction projects.

Successful candidates will have experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing vendors, contracts, project budgets, and schedules. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are essential, along with the ability to use structured methods to assess information, resolve challenges, and support timely decisions.

A Project Management Professional (PMP) credential or another recognized project management certification is preferred. Experience in semiconductor or similarly complex industrial construction is an advantage. Familiarity with business process improvement, risk analysis, or failure mode analysis is also beneficial. Experience with, or interest in, developing agentic AI workflows for current or future processes is welcome.

Responsibilities

Lead assigned construction projects and manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, and vendor performance from planning through completion. Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, identify dependencies, remove roadblocks, and coordinate alignment across functional teams and project stakeholders.

Establish and manage project financials, including estimates, forecasts, cash flow, and cost controls. Monitor performance against approved plans, communicate risks and variances, and take appropriate action to keep work on track. Lead design reviews, competitive bidding, contract execution, project programming, and development activities.

Ensure project work complies with Micron’s safety, environmental, and quality standards. Promote proactive hazard identification, timely resolution, and a strong safety culture. Coordinate teams and vendors to maintain quality, address project issues, and deliver facilities that meet technical and operational requirements.

Benefits

Micron is committed to supporting employee wellbeing and professional growth. Benefits are designed to help employees stay well, protect their income, and prepare for the future. Depending on location and plan eligibility, team members can choose medical, dental, and vision coverage suited to their healthcare needs and budget. Additional programs may include income protection for illness or injury, paid family leave, paid time off, and paid holidays. Benefit options and eligibility may vary by location; consult Micron’s Benefits Guide for details.

Equal Opportunity

Micron Technology Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Micron prohibits child labor and complies with applicable labor laws and standards. Candidates should provide accurate information in their applications; misrepresentation of skills or experience may result in disqualification.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Earth and Environment
jobs.description:
Ausenco is a fast-growing company with big ideas. We redefine what’s possible in some of the world’s most complex projects and toughest environments. Delivering innovative, value-add consulting, project delivery, asset operations and maintenance solutions is what we do. From 22 offices in 10 countries, with projects in over 80 locations worldwide, we create sustainable outcomes for our people, clients and communities.

We're seeking a Project Manager to support our Earth and Environment team in one of our offices in Burnaby, Victoria, Whitehorse, or Calgary.

If you enjoy bringing people together, tackling interesting challenges, and seeing projects through to success, this could be a great fit. You'll have the opportunity to work on a variety of environmental projects across North America, with a focus on Canada, alongside a talented and collaborative team that values fresh ideas, strong relationships, and finding better ways to get things done.

About The Role

As a Project Manager in our Earth & Environment business, you'll have the opportunity to lead exciting and challenging projects, bring together talented multidisciplinary teams, and build lasting relationships with our clients. You'll be at the heart of project delivery, working closely with technical leads and Project Controls to keep projects running smoothly, navigate challenges, and achieve great results for our clients and our business.

You'll work on a diverse range of environmental projects, including environmental assessments, regulatory and permitting programs, remediation projects, and related environmental studies. From early planning through to project completion, you'll help teams stay focused, connected, and moving in the right direction, drawing on the expertise of our senior technical specialists along the way.

This is also a great opportunity for someone who enjoys the people side of project management. You'll have the chance to strengthen client relationships, explore new opportunities, contribute to winning exciting work, and help colleagues grow and succeed. We're looking for someone who brings energy, initiative, and a collaborative spirit to the role, and who enjoys finding practical solutions to the challenges that make every project different.

Specific Tasks

Taking the lead on a variety of interesting and challenging environmental projects, bringing together the right people, plans, and resources to deliver great results for our clients.
Shaping projects from the outset by developing practical execution plans, setting clear priorities, and keeping teams aligned on scope, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.
Keeping projects on track by anticipating challenges, navigating changes, managing risks, and finding creative solutions when things don’t go quite as planned.
Taking ownership of project financial performance, working closely with Project Controls on budgets, forecasts, invoicing, and maintaining healthy project margins.
Bringing together multidisciplinary teams of technical specialists, fostering collaboration, resolving challenges, and helping everyone do their best work.
Building strong, trusted relationships with clients, keeping communication open and proactive, and making sure we deliver on our commitments.
Coordinating with subconsultants, vendors, and other project partners to keep work moving smoothly and deliverables on track.
Championing safety, quality, and environmental responsibility, ensuring these remain at the heart of how we plan and deliver our work.
Helping grow our business by spotting new opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and leading the development of compelling proposals.
Sharing your knowledge and experience with colleagues, mentoring developing project managers, and contributing ideas to continuously improve how we deliver projects.

Success in this role is about more than delivering projects on time and on budget. It's about building relationships that last, bringing out the best in your team, finding solutions to challenges, and creating an environment where people enjoy working together. You'll take pride in delivering great results for our clients while helping our team and business continue to grow.

About You

A university degree in engineering, environmental science, natural resource management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
8+ years of professional experience, including at least 5 years of relevant project management experience, preferably in a multidisciplinary environmental consulting or project delivery environment.
A natural relationship-builder who enjoys working with people, earns trust, and has demonstrated success developing strong, lasting relationships with clients, colleagues, and project partners.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with people at all levels, navigate challenging conversations, and bring different perspectives together to achieve shared goals.
Experience leading and motivating multidisciplinary teams, creating a positive and collaborative environment where people feel supported, valued, and empowered to do their best work.
You enjoy the challenge of keeping complex projects moving, balancing competing priorities, anticipating issues, and finding practical ways to deliver great results.
Sound financial and commercial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, project financial reporting, and an understanding of project controls processes.
A client-focused mindset, with experience identifying opportunities, contributing to business development, and developing proposals that respond to client needs.
A positive, adaptable approach and the confidence to take initiative, make decisions, and work through challenges with your team.
Experience delivering environmental projects, such as environmental assessments, regulatory and permitting programs, remediation projects, or related work, is an asset. A professional designation or eligibility for designation (e.g., P.Eng., R.P.Bio., EP, PMP) is also considered an asset.

The Staff Technical Program Manager will play a foundational role in building and scaling an AI-powered engineering platform that enables Product and Technology teams to work effectively with AI agents throughout the product development lifecycle. You will lead complex, cross-functional programs, turning emerging AI capabilities into secure, reliable, and reusable solutions. Working closely with engineering leaders and teams across the organization, you will drive platform delivery, establish operating models, and coordinate adoption across multiple business areas. You will also shape AI readiness by identifying gaps in skills, tooling, integrations, and governance, then building practical programs to address them. This is a high-impact opportunity to establish the foundations of a new Agentic Engineering function in a remote, fast-moving technology environment. The role combines strategic program leadership, technical fluency, organizational change, and hands-on experimentation with AI-enabled workflows.

Accountabilities

Partner with the Agentic Engineering team to define and manage the platform roadmap, milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans across reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance.
Coordinate the development and integration of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and other tools that engineering teams need to work effectively.
Establish and manage the team's operating cadence, including planning sessions, delivery reviews, decision logs, risk tracking, exception management, and retrospectives.
Make trade-offs involving scope, capacity, cost, model usage, compute resources, and delivery risks visible to stakeholders early.
Build an intake and prioritization framework for AI use cases and platform needs across Retail, Hospitality, Payments, and platform teams.
Coordinate early-adopter launches, gather feedback, and turn successful use cases into reusable patterns that can be adopted by other teams.
Partner with Engineering to define evaluation standards for agent quality, reliability, security, cost, and human oversight before AI solutions enter production workflows.
Coordinate Security, Privacy, Legal, Data, and Architecture stakeholders to integrate governance reviews and approvals into the delivery lifecycle.
Drive AI readiness across Product, Engineering, and Design by assessing individual capabilities, skills, and working practices, as well as organizational tooling, licenses, configurations, integrations, access, and permissions.
Work with Product and Technology leaders to move teams beyond basic AI tool usage toward measurable improvements in workflows, productivity, and customer value.
Collaborate with the Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) Technical Program Manager to align platform adoption with shared processes, baseline metrics, and performance objectives.
Partner with the Learning and Development Technical Program Manager to build and deliver enablement initiatives, including workshops, champion networks, and train-the-trainer programs.

Use AI agents and automation to improve program management activities such as status reporting, risk detection, follow-ups, and decision tracking, demonstrating measurable results.

At least 8 years of technical program management experience at the platform, infrastructure, or developer-experience level, with ownership of complex, multi-team programs.

Practical understanding of AI-enabled and agentic systems, including orchestration, tool use, retrieval and context management, evaluations, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Experience delivering internal platforms or shared engineering capabilities to multiple teams or internal customers with different priorities.
Proven ability to establish and standardize engineering practices across organizations while allowing for differences in team needs and workflows.
Experience building a program or operating model from the ground up, including governance, intake processes, delivery cadence, and stakeholder mechanisms.
Track record of partnering with Security, Privacy, Legal, or Risk teams to deliver technology programs in regulated or sensitive environments.

Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to present program progress, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders.
Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Our Medtronic Surgical team is working to bring the benefits of minimally invasive surgery (MIS) to more people and places through a portfolio of robotic & digital solutions. Together, we are working to broaden options and expand access globally for hospitals, surgeons, & patients.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. This position is remote to enhance our competitive edge and expand our cross-functional collaboration efforts. This role will require 50% travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

The Customer Marketing Program Manager is responsible for building and executing impactful brand experiences and events for target customers in the Hugo™ robotic-assisted surgery system pipeline. This role spans the full experience journey, from developing customer insights to designing and delivering end-to-end hands-on demonstrations.

This role will be responsible for the Western part of the US and must be based near a major airport. Denver, Houston, Dallas, Chicago and Los Angeles or San Diego would be considered.

In this role you will:

Align and coordinate cross-functional execution of field-based events, serving as program management and process lead for a fleet of three Medtronic Mobile Labs (MMLs) and Customer Experience Programs (CEPs) for Hugo™ across the United States.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the US Capital Sales team to intake requests and strategize solutions that enable hands-on experiences with Hugo™.
Orchestrate and integrate all elements of high-impact customer events, including promotional content, hands-on demonstrations, dinners/workshops & follow-up campaigns.
Lead the organization and coordination of the Hugo™ booth presence at US congresses and tradeshows, including demo systems, booth graphics, and staffing plans.
Collect and synthesize ongoing customer insights and feedback to assess event effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve overall customer experience.
Ensure MMLs and other customer engagement centers are properly stocked with required instruments, supplies, and accessories to support exceptional experiences.
Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including the US salesforce, US and global marketing teams, customer success, field service, physician relations, medical affairs, and other cross-functional partners.
Travel approximately 50% (primarily domestic)

Must Have: Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience in marketing, customer marketing, event marketing, program management or related roles, or 3+ years with an advanced degree
Proven experience planning and executing complex customer events, tradeshows, roadshows, or experiential marketing programs.

Nice to Have: Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or related field
Significant experience in marketing, customer marketing, event marketing or marketing program management
Demonstrated ability to partner with sales organizations to design and deliver customer-facing programs that drive pipeline and engagement.
Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent programs, timelines, and stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling customer experiences.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% (primarily domestic), including occasional evenings and weekends for events.
Experience in medical devices, healthcare, capital equipment, or robotic-assisted surgery.
Experience managing mobile labs, demo fleets, or other customer experience centers.
Background working with cross-functional teams (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Clinical, Customer Success, Field Service).
Familiarity with congress/tradeshow planning, including booth strategy, demo system coordination, and onsite logistics.
Experience using customer insights and data to optimize event design & campaigns.
Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and to influence without direct authority.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R.

214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.

‌

Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.

‌

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$130,400.00 - $195,600.00

‌

This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and specific locations in California. The offered rate complies with federal and local regulations and may vary based on factors such as experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others).

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to those regular employees who work 20+ hours per week: Health, Dental and vision insurance, Health Savings Account, Healthcare Flexible Spending Account, Life insurance, Long-term disability leave, Dependent daycare spending account, Tuition assistance/reimbursement, and Simple Steps (global well-being program).

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to all regular employees: Incentive plans, 401(k) plan plus employer contribution and match, Short-term disability, Paid time off, Paid holidays, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Employee Assistance Program, Non-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement (subject to IRS earning minimums), and Capital Accumulation Plan (available to Vice Presidents and above, or subject to IRS earning minimums).

Regular employees are those who are not temporary, such as interns. Temporary employees are eligible for paid sick time, as required under applicable state law, and the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Please note some of the above benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager II
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Project Manager II based in the United States (Remote).

In this role, you will lead complex software, digital, and business transformation initiatives that support innovation across healthcare technology, diagnostics, laboratory operations, and enterprise systems. You will oversee projects from initial concept through deployment, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and successful delivery across multiple teams. Working closely with stakeholders in Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Finance, you will drive Agile execution, coordinate resources, and manage critical dependencies. You will establish effective program governance, monitor budgets and timelines, and ensure that delivery milestones are consistently achieved. As a trusted partner to senior leadership, you will provide strategic insights, resolve challenges, and promote accountability across the organization. This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful healthcare innovation while working in a collaborative, technology-driven environment focused on improving patient outcomes.

Accountabilities

Lead complex software development, digital transformation, and business initiatives from initial planning and concept through implementation and deployment.
Drive Agile project delivery across multiple cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and business objectives.
Develop, maintain, and oversee comprehensive program plans, project roadmaps, budgets, and resource forecasts.
Manage project scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, resources, and delivery commitments to ensure successful execution.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Finance teams to coordinate activities and maintain alignment across initiatives.
Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, release planning, and continuous improvement sessions.
Establish and maintain program governance frameworks, performance metrics, dashboards, and reporting processes to monitor progress and delivery outcomes.
Ensure adherence to Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) standards, quality management processes, validation requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
Prepare and present project updates, delivery performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to senior management and executive stakeholders.
Influence key decisions, proactively identify and resolve roadblocks, and maintain accountability across project teams and organizational stakeholders.
Optimize resource allocation, manage competing priorities, and support efficient execution across multiple interconnected programs.
Identify opportunities to improve project management practices, streamline delivery processes, and accelerate organizational performance.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Information Systems, Business, or a related discipline.
At least 8 years of project or program management experience, with a proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Minimum of 5 years of experience managing software development, digital products, SaaS solutions, data platforms, or enterprise technology projects.
Strong experience managing Agile software delivery teams using Scrum, Kanban, or scaled Agile methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and organizational dependencies.
Experience with portfolio management, resource allocation, financial planning, budget forecasting, and executive-level reporting.
Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, release management, change management, and product development processes.
Excellent organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and maintain attention to detail.
Outstanding communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex project information into clear executive-level updates.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders, build strong cross-functional relationships, and collaborate effectively across all organizational levels.
Strong leadership and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to make informed decisions, manage risks, and drive accountability.
Adaptability and a proactive approach to navigating changing priorities and complex project environments.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, collaborative environment while maintaining ownership of project outcomes.

Benefits

Competitive annual base salary for US-based remote positions ranging from $126,000 to $158,000, depending on experience, qualifications, education, and location.
For positions based in the San Francisco Bay Area, the anticipated annual base salary range is $140,000 to $175,000.
Potential eligibility for additional discretionary bonuses and incentive compensation.
Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to eligibility.
Comprehensive health and welfare benefits.
401(k) retirement savings plan with employer matching contributions.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Gym reimbursement program.
Pre-tax commuter benefits.
Additional employee benefits and well-being programs.
Special Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy providing eligible full-time employees with up to 30 days of paid leave annually following organ or bone marrow donation.
Opportunity to contribute to innovative healthcare technology and solutions that support transplant patients and improve clinical outcomes.
Collaborative and purpose-driven working environment with opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Manufacturing Transfers
jobs.description:
Exceptional People. Hard Problems. Meaningful Careers. Big Impact.

Nowhere else can you touch as many life-changing medical technologies. At Forj Medical, we work side by side with more than 100 medical device companies from startups to global giants to bring life-enhancing technologies to market. Working with us means solving hard problems with extraordinary people in a collaborative work environment. Join us.

Senior Program Manager, Manufacturing Transfers

Exceptional People. Hard Problems. Meaningful Careers. Big Impact. Nowhere else can you touch as many life-changing medical technologies. At Forj Medical, we work side by side with more than 100 medical device companies from startups to global giants to bring life-enhancing technologies to market. Working with us means solving hard problems with extraordinary people in a collaborative work environment. Join us.

Job Summary

The Senior Program Manager will build and lead Forj Medical's manufacturing transfer program from the ground up. Sitting within Operations, this role owns the planning and execution of production line transfers, site transfers, and site decommissioning activities, including transfers to our Costa Rica facility and other locations outside the United States.This is a foundational role. You will set how transfer programs are planned, tracked, and executed at Forj Medical, and as the transfer portfolio grows, you will have the opportunity to scale the function and help hire the team.

The Senior PM is primarily internally focused, aligning sending sites, receiving sites, engineering, production, quality, regulatory, supply chain, facilities, IS, HR, Finance, and the Forj Medical leadership team. The role partners closely with our customer-facing Program Management Office, which owns customer communication.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Build the transfer program function from the ground up, establishing the standard approach, tools, templates, and governance for production line and site transfers.
Lead multiple concurrent transfer programs end to end, including transfer strategy, stakeholder alignment, knowledge transfer, documentation readiness, equipment and process transition, validation support, training, production ramp, and post-transfer stabilization.
Build realistic, defensible schedules grounded in a working knowledge of equipment, processes, and operator and assembler learning curves. Independently assess and challenge estimates from sending and receiving sites, including during site closures, where input may be incomplete or overly optimistic.
Develop and own detailed program plans in MS Project/Planner or comparable project management software, including schedules, resource allocation, budgets, and milestones.
Direct program execution with minimal oversight, including schedule adherence, budget, scope changes, risk and issue management, and escalation of anything impacting schedule, quality, cost, or regulatory expectations.
Lead cross-site and international transfer activities, with significant coordination with the Costa Rica site, ensuring clear communication across time zones and clear ownership of roles and responsibilities.
Lead cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment, balancing urgency and accountability with empathy for employees affected by site transitions and closures.
Report program status, risks, and recommendations to Operations leadership.
Partner with the customer-facing Program Management Office to keep customer commitments aligned with transfer plans.
Continuously improve Forj Medical's transfer processes and define the future-state structure of the transfer program function.

Qualifications

B.S. or M.S. required, preferably in a technical, engineering, operations, or related field; PMP certification a plus.
8+ years of project or program management experience in medical device manufacturing (OEM or contract manufacturing).
Demonstrated experience leading production line transfers, site transfers, or production ramp activities, including transfers involving multiple facilities or locations outside the United States.
Proven ability to build and manage complex project plans in MS Project/Planner or comparable project management software. Spreadsheet-based tracking alone is not sufficient.
Strong technical and operational understanding of manufacturing equipment, processes, and training needs, sufficient to validate timelines and resource requirements.
Track record of driving results through strong stakeholder management, with a high degree of organization and attention to detail.
Experience building or scaling a program management function, process, or team preferred.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical and business concepts clearly to leadership, engineers, and production teams.
Understanding of FDA, ISO 9001, and ISO 13485 required.
Ability to travel approximately 30%, including international travel.

Location:
Minnesota preferred. Candidates based in Costa Rica will also be considered.

EEO Statement

Forj Medical provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Employment Requirement

Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Compensation And Total Rewards Package

The salary range for this position is outlined below under "Job Details" and is dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable employment laws. Beyond base salary, Forj offers a competitive Total Rewards Package. We offer health, dental, vision, 401K plans, and time off programs. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual bonus program which depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance.

Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today: time to get life-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.

We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of Biopharma Solutions. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

It’s all part of our time-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

Beckman Coulter Life Sciences is looking for an experienced Project Manager who independently leads moderately complex New Product Development (NPD) and/or Sustaining projects from planning through execution. Apply strong project-management practices, business judgment, and cross-functional leadership to deliver projects against scope, schedule, budget, risk, and customer objectives.

The Project Manager
is responsible to independently lead moderately complex NPD and Sustaining projects in a regulated product-development environment, applying disciplined project planning, proactive risk management, financial acumen, cross-functional leadership, and data-driven decision making to deliver customer and business outcomes. The position ensures that high-impact product development and sustainment programs within the Life Sciences Biopharma Solutions product portfolio are delivered on time, within scope, and in alignment with business strategy, enabling collaboration among scientific, technical, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing and commercial stakeholders.

This position reports directly to the BioPharma Senior Manager PMO – R&D
and is an integral part of the Global PMO - R&D organization. This role is an on-site role based in Beckman Coulter Life Sciences sites located in Indianapolis, IN or Loveland, CO.
This role will require periodic travel to team sites to attend meetings, training and reviews, as well as to execute Gemba walks in support of a functionally excellent teams located at Loveland, CO, Indianapolis, IN and Aachen, Germany sites.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Independently lead at least one moderately complex NPD or Sustaining project through the product development lifecycle, establishing clear scope, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, decision points, and ownership.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans with realistic task durations, critical paths, resource assumptions, and phase-gate commitments based on project scope, technical complexity, and risk.
Develop and manage project budgets and recommend trade-off decisions across scope, schedule, cost, resources, risk, quality, and product value. Lead cross-functional teams with moderate resource requirements, risk, and complexity; resolve conflicts, remove obstacles, and build shared accountability in a matrixed environment.
Manage cross-functional program and project teams, resolving conflicts, removing obstacles, and building shared accountability.
Partner cross-functionally with development, product management, regulatory, quality, operations, finance, legal, commercial, and marketing leaders within the organization to align objectives and ensure successful program outcomes.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biological Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
Prefer 5+ years of experience in the life sciences, diagnostics, medical device, or related regulated industry or 3+ years with an advanced (MS/PhD) degree in Engineering, Science or related field.
Prefer 3+ years of experience leading complex product development programs from concept through commercialization.
Demonstrated knowledge of the end-to-end product development process and experience developing products under design control in a regulated life science, or similarly regulated environment.
Ability to translate scientific and technical information into clear program strategies. Strong analytical, financial, and risk management skills.
Effective communication, facilitation, negotiation, and influencing skills, including the ability to build consensus and communicate emerging risks, mitigations, options, and trade-offs to stakeholders and leadership.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements

Ability to travel both domestically and internationally to support geographically distributed teams and sites, attend training and workshops, and program review meeting

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Strong knowledge of scientific and regulatory development processes (e.g., innovation product development lifecycle, design control, and regulated development).
PMP/PgMP or similar certification a plus.

jobs.title: SOC Program Manager - Semicon Only

SOC Program Manager – Role Overview

The SOC Program Manager is accountable for the complete lifecycle of System‑on‑Chip (SoC) projects. This includes creating and owning the program plan (schedule, budget, resources, deliverables, and risk), driving the initiative from concept through tape‑out and into commercialization, and coordinating with design, verification, DFT, physical design, system‑emulation, IP, and other functional groups.
Core Responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

Define scope, schedule, budget, resources, and key milestones for complex SoC initiatives.

jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

RBC's AI-Driven Software Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) program is scaling across Technology & Operations through a franchise model. A central team owns the method, platform, measurement and playbook. Each L3 (Senior Executive) acts as a franchise, owning local execution, adoption and sustained ownership under a named AI-DLC Lead. With a target of 15,000 staff enabled by mid-FY27, the model depends on clear process and disciplined program management.

As Senior Program Manager, Change & Transformation, you will own delivery of the Franchise Model rollout, reporting to the Delivery & Exec Lead, Live Programs. You will be accountable for moving each L3 from kickoff to steady state on time: entry gates passed, 12-week adoption plan on track, and Central teams delivering what each L3 needs.

You will plan and sequence the rollout, coordinate L3 Leads and Central teams (Change & Learning, Platform, Benefits & Baseline), run the gate and waiver process with Technology ESG, and give decision-makers accurate, timely information. You must be comfortable in a high-visibility environment and able to hold direct conversations with Senior Director-level AI-DLC Leads about unmet gates.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Rollout Planning: Own the end-to-end L3 franchise rollout plan: sequencing, milestones, dependencies and calendar, from kickoff through steady state.
Entry Gates & Waivers: Drive each L3 through the five entry gates (roles staffed, readiness assessed, plan signed, platform ready, champion layer active) with L3 Leads and Technology ESG. Run the waiver process with a gap, closing date and owner, surface expiring waivers early, and allow no silent renewals.
Adoption & Readiness: Support each L3 through the 12-week adoption plan and readiness assessment, including white-glove or self-serve triage. Flag drift against handbook milestones and agree corrective actions with the Lead.
Central Team Coordination: Coordinate dependencies between L3s and Central teams (Live Programs, Change & Learning, Platform, Benefits & Baseline), and hold each team to its commitments. Resolve cross-L3 conflicts and capacity gaps, or take them to the right forum.
Forums & L3 Front Door: Run franchise forums, kickoffs, training and certification milestones, office hours and Demo Days. Route L3 questions to the right Central team, log them by topic, and track response times.
Tracking & Reporting: Maintain the franchise tracker as the single view of every L3 (gates, milestones, staffing, training, actions). Collect and check monthly funnel and RAG reports, and contribute content to Technology ESG and OC briefings with Lead Operations.
Escalation: Escalate off-track L3s or Central dependencies to the Delivery & Exec Lead and Technology ESG with context and a recommended path, and follow through to resolution. Work with the Program Manager to triage working-level issues.
Continuous Improvement: Capture feedback from L3 Leads, orchestrators and Change Champions, and analyze recurring questions, gate failures and blockers. Keep the handbook, templates and checklists current, and share lessons from early franchises.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO SUCCEED?

Must have:

Experience: 8+ years in program or delivery management within large-scale technology transformation, financial services, or enterprise change programs, ideally in a large regulated enterprise with formal governance structures
Multi-Stakeholder Rollout: Proven ability to run a rollout across many business units or teams, holding other leaders to commitments without direct authority.
Senior Stakeholder Management: Credibility to hold direct, candid conversations with Senior Directors and executive sponsors.
Process Discipline & Communication: Strong organization to track many concurrent workstreams, owners and deadlines accurately, with clear, concise written and verbal communication for senior audiences.
Tooling & Independence: Proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook, turning raw data into executive-facing views. Comfortable working independently in a vendor or staff augmentation capacity with minimal oversight.

Nice-to-have
:

Prior experience supporting AI, Agile, or SDLC transformation programs, or familiarity with AI-Native SDLC concepts.
Experience with a franchise, federated, hub-and-spoke or center-of-excellence rollout model.
Experience with change management, training rollout or adoption programs.
Familiarity with benefit measurement or baseline methodology.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

jobs.description:
Jersey City, NJ

View all jobsApply Now

Forbes is an iconic global media brand that has symbolized success for over a century. Fueled by journalism that informs and inspires, Forbes spotlights the doers and doings shaping industries, achieving success and making an impact on the world. Forbes connects and convenes the most influential communities ranging from billionaires, business leaders and rising entrepreneurs to creators and innovators. The Forbes brand reaches more than 140 million people monthly worldwide through its trusted journalism, signature ForbesLive events and 49 licensed local editions in 81 countries.

Forbes is seeking an Cyber Security Manager
responsible for protecting Forbes' corporate technology environment and consumer-facing digital platforms through the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity controls, processes, and governance. This is a hands-on technical leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Technology, with formal people-management responsibility for a small distributed team of onshore employees and offshore contractors.

This individual will own cybersecurity across two complementary domains: corporate technology security, spanning identity and access management, endpoint protection, network and cloud security, email and phishing defense, and compliance; and web platform security, spanning cloud infrastructure, source code and pipeline security, vulnerability management, and client-side protection for Forbes' digital properties. The role also serves as the governance lead for all cybersecurity matters across the organization, partnering closely with Infrastructure, Engineering, QA, Product, Legal, and Corporate Technology teams. The ideal candidate is both a technical security expert and a business-minded collaborator, capable of balancing security requirements with operational efficiency and business objectives.

This is a hybrid position based at Forbes' Jersey City headquarters, with an expectation of working in the office 2-3 days per week. Candidates should reside in New Jersey, New York, or the greater New York City metropolitan area.

Responsibilities

Leadership and Governance

Lead, mentor, and manage a distributed team of onshore employees and offshore contractors supporting corporate technology and web platform security.
Manage direct reports, goal setting, performance reviews, professional development, and day-to-day prioritization of work.
Oversee offshore contractor engagements, including deliverables, work quality, and coordination with vendor and resource management.
Serve as the governance lead for all cybersecurity matters across the organization, setting direction, standards, and priorities.
Develop and maintain company-wide cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and technical documentation.
Partner with Legal on vendor security preparation and review, including NDAs, data processing agreements (DPAs), and vendor risk assessments.
Manage cybersecurity projects, operational requests, and remediation initiatives, ensuring timely execution and resolution.
Support PCI and other compliance initiatives, audits, and security assessments, including evidence collection and questionnaire responses.
Maintain security metrics, reporting, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into organizational risk.
Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats and vulnerabilities, recommending improvements to strengthen Forbes' security posture.
Serve as the organization's designated HIPAA Security Officer, ensuring compliance with the HIPAA Security Rule and overseeing the protection of electronic protected health information (ePHI).

Corporate Technology Security

Administer and secure the enterprise identity and access management (SSO/MFA) platform, including authentication policies, identity lifecycle automation, and privileged access controls.
Manage endpoint detection and response (EDR) and endpoint protection across the enterprise device fleet.
Manage enterprise network security, including next-generation firewalls, switching infrastructure, and cloud network environments.
Secure the enterprise cloud identity and directory environment, including conditional access, session controls, and account hygiene.
Manage email security and phishing defense, including phishing investigation and triage, security awareness training, and phishing simulation programs.
Lead security incident investigations and response efforts, coordinating remediation and root-cause analysis activities.

Web and Digital Platform Security

Manage cloud network architecture and security controls for Forbes' consumer-facing digital platforms.
Oversee source code and development platform security, including repository access controls, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline security.
Own the vulnerability scanning and vulnerability management program across web properties and infrastructure, driving remediation with Engineering.
Lead client-side security for web properties, including governance of third-party scripts and tags and browser-side protections.
Partner with Engineering, QA, and Product teams to embed security requirements and best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.

The Ideal Candidate

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
CISSP, CCSP, CISM, Security+ and/or GIAC certifications preferred.
7+ years of cybersecurity experience, including cloud security, infrastructure security, network security, or security engineering.
Experience leading and developing security engineers, including distributed and offshore team members or contractors.
Experience with the HIPAA Security Rule and protecting electronic protected health information (ePHI) is preferred
Experience managing enterprise productivity suites, identity and access management platforms, public cloud platforms, and endpoint protection and threat detection solutions.
Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, network infrastructure, and cloud networking across multiple cloud providers.
Practical experience applying AI tools to security and engineering workflows, such as automation, detection, triage, and reporting, and familiarity with governing safe AI adoption across an enterprise.
Strong scripting and automation skills for security workflow and identity lifecycle automation.
Experience supporting PCI audits, compliance assessments, and security reviews.
Deep understanding of identity management, privileged access controls, authentication, and authorization principles.
Skilled in leading investigations, incident response, vulnerability management, and threat analysis.
Experience developing and maintaining security policies, standards, and governance processes.
Experience partnering with legal and procurement teams on vendor security reviews and contract preparation.
Proven ability to balance strategic security initiatives with hands-on technical execution.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The annual base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $175,000.

This position is only open to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, & Washington. FOMO is looking for a Data Analyst to own the reporting data layer behind its payments and cross-border business. Capture reporting needs from business owners and convert them into metric definitions, dimensions, filters and refresh requirements.

Enable self-service through documentation, training and office hours.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (Information Management Associate)
jobs.description:
As SISSIRP advances into full implementation, there is a critical need for structured information management to ensure that field data is systematically collected, cleaned, analyzed, and translated into actionable programme intelligence for project management, donor reporting, and decision-making. The programme currently operates across multiple data streams — physical progress, WASH outputs, quality assessments, procurement milestones, and beneficiary data — that require integration, visualization, and quality control to meet AfDB M&E and reporting standards.
Under the direct supervision of the Programme Officer (Engineering) and the overall guidance of the Programme Manager, the Information Management Associate will serve as the dedicated IM focal point for the SISSIRP programme. The incumbent will design, maintain, and continuously improve the programme’s data collection systems, analytical products, and reporting dashboards, enabling senior programme staff and client management to make evidence-based decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

1. Data Collection Systems – KoBoToolbox

Design, build, and maintain KoBoToolbox data collection forms for all programme components, including physical progress monitoring, QA/QC inspections, WASH output tracking, beneficiary data, and field verification exercises; ensure forms are version-controlled, piloted, and deployed consistently across all four project states.
Manage the end-to-end data pipeline from field submission through KoBoToolbox to consolidated datasets: monitor submission rates, identify and resolve data gaps, run automated validation checks (range, logic, required fields), and flag anomalies to field engineers for correction.
Develop and maintain standardized data collection protocols and field data submission procedures; conduct remote and in-person training sessions for site engineers and state-level staff on KoBoToolbox form usage, data quality standards, and submission workflows.
Support integration of KoBoToolbox data exports with downstream analysis and reporting tools (Excel, Power BI), ensuring data formats, coding conventions, and field labels are consistent and transformation-ready.
Maintain and document all active KoBoToolbox projects, form versions, user permissions, and data export schedules; ensure data is backed up and stored in line with IOM data governance standards.

2. Data Analysis and Visualization – Excel & Power BI

Build and maintain Advanced Excel workbooks for programme data management and analysis, including:

- Dynamic pivot tables linked to live data exports.
- Data reconciliation across multiple registers.
- Structured data validation and dropdown controls to enforce data integrity.
- Conditional formatting for status flags, overdue items, and threshold breaches.
- Automated summary dashboards using Excel formulas and slicers to generate programme KPIs without manual recalculation.
Develop, publish, and maintain Power BI dashboards providing real-time programme intelligence for SISSIRP management and AfDB reporting. Dashboards should cover:

- Physical progress by state, sector, and facility type.
- Procurement and contract milestone tracking.
- WASH output indicators (coverage, functionality, beneficiary reach).
- QA/QC pass/fail rates.
- Financial disbursement progress against targets.
Apply DAX measures and calculated columns in Power BI to derive programme-level KPIs (e.g., % facilities completed, cost per beneficiary, average construction duration) and configure row-level security to control data access by state and role.
Design and implement data models in Power BI connecting multiple source tables (progress trackers, procurement registers, beneficiary data, KoBoToolbox exports) via defined relationships, ensuring dashboard figures reconcile with source data.
Produce periodic analytical reports and data summaries (weekly, monthly, quarterly) for the Programme Officer, Programme Manager, and donor reporting requirements; translate data outputs into clear narrative findings with supporting charts and maps.
Support GIS-based analysis and mapping of SISSIRP facilities using available tools (Excel/Power BI map visuals, QGIS where applicable) to visualize geographic distribution of project activities and outputs.

3. Programme Reporting and M&E Support

Serve as the IM focal point for all AfDB progress reporting requirements: compile, quality-check, and format data inputs from field teams into the programme’s standard reporting templates in line with AfDB M&E frameworks and SISSIRP’s Results Framework indicators.
Maintain the SISSIRP master data register: a single source of truth for all facility-level progress data, updated on a rolling basis from field inputs, reconciled against procurement and payment records, and shared with the Programme Officer and Programme Manager on a weekly basis.
Support the preparation of donor progress reports, quarterly reviews, and AfDB supervision mission briefings by providing accurate, well-visualized data summaries, programme maps, and indicator tables.
Maintain the programme’s document management system for IM-related files, including data dictionaries, codebooks, form versions, and dashboard user guides.

4. IM Capacity Support and Quality Assurance

Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting to field teams on KoBoToolbox, Excel, and Power BI; respond to data queries from site engineers and state-level staff within one working day.
Develop and maintain user guides, data dictionaries, and standard operating procedures for all IM tools and systems used under SISSIRP.
Conduct periodic data quality reviews across all programme components; produce data quality assessment reports with findings and corrective recommendations for the Programme Officer.
Perform such other duties as may be assigned by the Programme Officer (Engineering) or Programme Manager.

Required Qualifications and Experience

Education & Experience – Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Management, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited academic institution, with four years of relevant professional experience; or
Completed High School Degree / Certificate with six years of relevant professional experience.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with KoBoToolbox (or ODK/Kobo Collect): designing multi-section forms with skip logic, validation constraints, and repeat groups; managing projects and user permissions; exporting and cleaning datasets.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including:

- Dynamic pivot tables and pivot charts.
- VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP.
- Nested IF / IFS, COUNTIFS, SUMIFS.
- Data validation and structured tables.
- Power Query for data transformation.
- Conditional formatting and dashboard construction.
Demonstrated experience building and publishing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data model design, DAX measures, calculated columns, and Power BI Service publishing and access management.
Familiarity with infrastructure, WASH, or humanitarian programme data is a strong advantage.
Experience with QGIS or other GIS tools for mapping and spatial analysis is an advantage.

Skills

Expert-level proficiency in KoBoToolbox: form design (XLSForm or online builder), skip logic, validation constraints, repeat groups, multi-language forms, data export, and project management.
Advanced Excel: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP, Power Query (M language), nested formulas, data validation, conditional formatting, dynamic dashboards without VBA.
Power BI: data modelling (star schema), DAX (CALCULATE, FILTER, RELATED, time-intelligence), report design principles, Power BI Service (workspaces, row-level security, scheduled refresh, sharing).
Strong analytical and data quality skills: ability to identify and resolve inconsistencies, outliers, and gaps in field datasets.
Clear data communication skills: ability to translate raw datasets into concise visual summaries, charts, and written findings for non-technical audiences.
Proficiency in Microsoft SharePoint / OneDrive for IM file management and team data sharing.
Working knowledge of Results Frameworks, Indicator Tracking Tables, and logframe-based M&E; familiarity with AfDB reporting standards is a strong advantage.
Ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams simultaneously and deliver outputs to tight deadlines.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and audit-readiness.

DELIVERABLES
The Information Management Associate shall produce and maintain the following on an ongoing basis:
Maintained and operational KoBoToolbox data collection system across all SISSIRP programme components and states, with version-controlled forms, active user management, and documented protocols.
Weekly SISSIRP Master Data Register update: facility-level progress, procurement, and WASH output data consolidated, cleaned, and shared with the Programme Officer.
Power BI dashboard suite (programme overview, state-level progress, WASH outputs, procurement milestones) — published, refreshed, and shared with programme management on a rolling basis.
Monthly data quality assessment report: submission rates, error flags, correction actions, and unresolved gaps.
Quarterly IM inputs for AfDB progress reporting: data tables, indicator summaries, maps, and charts formatted to AfDB reporting standards.
IM system documentation: data dictionary, KoBoToolbox form register, Power BI user guide, and standard operating procedures — kept current and accessible to the programme team.

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.
